What this number is not
The film-scale effective diffusivity measured here is not the reactor-scale dispersion coefficient that currently carries the same name in radial_parms (1×10⁻³ cm² s⁻¹, about 43× water’s
It is the quantity slab_parms carries as D_eff (1×10⁻⁵ cm² s⁻¹) — the one default in that file below water self-diffusivity.
